events.title: 🎉100,000+ Dudes & 15,000+ Wishlists in Less Than a Month!❤️
events.summary: 100,000+ players. 15,000+ wishlists. WHAT?! 🤯❤️ We never imagined so many dudes would be dancing, punching each other, and struggling through our puzzles! 😂🥊 Reaching these numbers in less than a month makes us incredibly happy! Seeing how fast our little game is growing, along with all your videos, streams, and reactions, means the world to us. ❤️ We're working hard to bring you even more chaos in the full game! 🔥 Thank you for trusting us, dudes! ❤️ Dude, trust me. We're just getting started!

events.title: 🎃 Dude, Trust Me is in costume for Halloween 🦇
events.summary: Halloween is here, just in time for Steam Next Fest. Grab your two friends and see who you're stuck with this time. 🎭 Costumes The Blind's head is a jack-o'-lantern, and its grin moves when you talk. The Deaf wears devil horns over the headphones. The Mute found a witch hat. Sefik wears a carved pumpkin. 🕸️ Four maps, dressed up The Offering Fire: jack-o'-lanterns, a scarecrow and string lights, with bats circling overhead. events.title: Voice chat issues: what's going on
events.summary: Update (16 Oct, 17:20 UTC): Our voice provider has fixed the issue and voice chat is working again. If you still can't hear your friends, go back to the main menu and rejoin. Thanks for your patience! Hey everyone, Since around 12:00 UTC today, many of you have had trouble with voice chat: not being able to join, voice cutting out after finishing a level, or the game saying voice is unavailable. events.title: The Wait Is Over! Dude, Trust Me Demo Is Here!
events.summary: The wait is over! The free demo of Dude, Trust Me is now live on Steam! Jump into a 3-player co-op adventure and find out how well your team can communicate. What's in the demo? • 4 levels with their own environments and mechanics. • 6 puzzles with different difficulties. • A lobby browser to find your team. • In-game voice chat shaped by your role. • Dancing, punching, and hand gestures for when words fail you. events.title: 1,000 Wishlists! A Thousand Dudes Trusted Us
events.summary: 1,000 wishlists!We saw the number this morning and just sat there smiling for a while. A thousand people looked at a game about three guys who can't see, hear or talk, and thought "yeah, I'd play that with my friends." That means a lot to us.Thank you for being here this early. We're still building, and we'll keep sharing as we go.See you soon, The Dude, Trust Me team
